ministry: Ministry of Finance
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
objective: Universal access to banking, remittance, credit, insurance and pension for unbanked households
benefit_summary: Zero-balance savings account with RuPay debit card, accident cover and overdraft facility
loan_support: Overdraft up to a prescribed limit after satisfactory operation
coverage: National (all districts)
application_mode: Offline (bank branch); Online (bank portal); Business Correspondent
data_source: PMJDY scheme portal; Department of Financial Services
notes: Foundational account layer that most DBT schemes credit into

ministry: Ministry of Finance
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
objective: Affordable accidental death and disability insurance for bank account holders
benefit_summary: Accidental death and permanent disability cover on annual auto-debit premium
coverage: National; age 18-70 bank account holders
application_mode: Offline (bank branch); Online (net banking auto-debit)
data_source: Jan Suraksha portal; Department of Financial Services
notes: Premium and cover amounts revised periodically; re-verify at portal

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Finance
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
objective: Affordable life insurance for bank account holders
benefit_summary: Life cover on annual auto-debit premium, renewable yearly
coverage: National; age 18-50 bank account holders at entry
application_mode: Offline (bank branch); Online (net banking auto-debit)
data_source: Jan Suraksha portal; Department of Financial Services
notes: Entry age capped at 50; cover continues to a prescribed exit age

ministry: Ministry of Finance
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
objective: Guaranteed minimum pension after age 60 for unorganised-sector workers
benefit_summary: Defined monthly pension from age 60 based on contribution slab chosen
coverage: National; age 18-40 at enrolment
application_mode: Offline (bank branch); Online (net banking)
data_source: PFRDA; NPS Trust
notes: Administered by PFRDA; income-tax payers excluded from co-contribution

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
objective: Direct income support to land-holding farmer families
benefit_summary: Income support paid in three equal instalments per year by direct benefit transfer
coverage: National; land-holding farmer families
application_mode: Online (PM-KISAN portal); Offline (Common Service Centre; village revenue office)
data_source: PM-KISAN scheme portal
notes: Amount per instalment is set by scheme rules and revised by notification; re-verify at portal

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
objective: Crop insurance against yield loss from natural calamity, pest and disease
benefit_summary: Sum-insured cover per notified crop with subsidised farmer premium share
coverage: National; notified crops in notified areas
application_mode: Online (PMFBY portal); Offline (bank; insurance intermediary; CSC)
data_source: PMFBY scheme portal
notes: Farmer premium share differs for kharif, rabi and commercial/horticultural crops

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
objective: Short-term working capital credit for crop production and allied activity
benefit_summary: Revolving credit limit with interest subvention and prompt-repayment incentive
coverage: National; all categories of farmers including tenant farmers and sharecroppers
application_mode: Offline (bank branch); Online (bank portal)
data_source: NABARD; Department of Agriculture
notes: Collateral-free up to a prescribed limit; extended to animal husbandry and fisheries

ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti
department: Department of Water Resources
objective: Expand irrigation coverage and improve water-use efficiency (Per Drop More Crop)
benefit_summary: Capital subsidy on micro-irrigation systems and watershed development support
coverage: National; differs by command and non-command area
application_mode: Offline (district or block agriculture office); Online (state portal)
data_source: PMKSY scheme portal
notes: Subsidy share differs by state and farmer category (small/marginal vs other)

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
objective: Increase farm mechanisation reach for small and marginal holdings
benefit_summary: Capital subsidy on farm machinery purchase and custom-hiring centre establishment
coverage: National; individual farmers, SHGs, FPOs and cooperatives
application_mode: Online (state agriculture portal); Offline (district agriculture office)
data_source: Farm Mechanization portal; Department of Agriculture
notes: Subsidy percentage differs for SC/ST/small/marginal/women farmers

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
objective: Promote organic farming through cluster-based conversion and certification support
benefit_summary: Per-hectare assistance across a three-year conversion cycle plus certification support
coverage: National; cluster-based (minimum farmer group per cluster)
application_mode: Offline (district agriculture office); Online (state portal)
data_source: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
notes: Operates on a cluster model; individual application is not the route

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
objective: Provide farmers with soil nutrient status and fertiliser recommendations
benefit_summary: Free soil testing and a nutrient-recommendation card per holding
coverage: National
application_mode: Offline (soil testing laboratory; village agriculture office); Online (SHC portal)
data_source: Soil Health Card portal
notes: Service delivery scheme; no cash transfer component

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
objective: Finance post-harvest management and community farming asset creation
benefit_summary: Interest subvention and credit guarantee on term loans for eligible projects
coverage: National; FPOs, PACS, cooperatives, agri-entrepreneurs, startups
application_mode: Online (AIF portal); Offline (lending bank)
data_source: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund portal
notes: Interest subvention applies up to a prescribed loan ceiling per project

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
department: MNRE
objective: Solarise agriculture pumps and enable farmer solar power generation
benefit_summary: Capital subsidy on standalone solar pumps, grid-connected pump solarisation and small solar plants
coverage: National; three components (A, B, C) with differing eligibility
application_mode: Online (state nodal agency portal); Offline (DISCOM; state nodal agency)
data_source: PM-KUSUM portal; Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
notes: Central and state subsidy shares plus farmer contribution; ratios differ by component

ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
department: Office of Development Commissioner (MSME); KVIC
objective: Generate self-employment through micro-enterprise creation in rural and urban areas
benefit_summary: Bank loan with margin money subsidy on project cost
coverage: National; individuals above 18, SHGs, institutions, cooperatives
application_mode: Online (PMEGP e-portal)
data_source: PMEGP e-portal; KVIC
notes: Margin money subsidy percentage differs by category (general vs special) and area (rural vs urban)

ministry: Ministry of Finance
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
objective: Collateral-free institutional credit to non-farm micro enterprises
benefit_summary: Term loan or working capital under Shishu, Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus categories
coverage: National; non-corporate non-farm micro enterprises
application_mode: Offline (bank; NBFC; MFI); Online (Jan Samarth portal)
data_source: MUDRA; Department of Financial Services
notes: Loan ceilings per category are revised by notification; re-verify at portal

ministry: Ministry of Finance
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
objective: Facilitate bank loans to SC, ST and women entrepreneurs for greenfield enterprises
benefit_summary: Composite bank loan (term loan plus working capital) for a first-time greenfield venture
coverage: National; SC, ST and women entrepreneurs above 18
application_mode: Online (Stand-Up India portal); Offline (scheduled commercial bank)
data_source: Stand-Up India portal
notes: Greenfield requirement: applicant must be a first-time entrepreneur in that activity

scheme_name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
department: Office of Development Commissioner (MSME); SIDBI
objective: Enable collateral-free credit to micro and small enterprises through guarantee cover
benefit_summary: Guarantee cover to the lender on eligible credit facilities, removing the collateral barrier
financial_assistance: Not applicable (guarantee to lender, not cash to borrower)
coverage: National; micro and small enterprises borrowing from member lending institutions
application_mode: Offline (through the lending institution; not a direct citizen application)
data_source: CGTMSE
notes: The borrower does not apply directly; the lender invokes cover

ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
department: Ministry of MSME
objective: End-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople in eighteen trades
benefit_summary: Skill training with stipend, toolkit incentive, collateral-free credit and digital/marketing support
coverage: National; artisans in eighteen notified traditional trades
application_mode: Online (PM Vishwakarma portal); Offline (Common Service Centre)
data_source: PM Vishwakarma portal
notes: Multi-component scheme; credit is released in tranches conditional on training

scheme_name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises
ministry: Ministry of Food Processing Industries
department: MoFPI
objective: Formalise and upgrade micro food-processing enterprises with a One District One Product focus
benefit_summary: Credit-linked capital subsidy on project cost, plus seed capital to SHG members and branding support
coverage: National; individual micro food processors, SHGs, FPOs, cooperatives
application_mode: Online (PMFME portal)
data_source: PMFME portal; Ministry of Food Processing Industries
notes: Subsidy is capped per unit; ODOP alignment affects prioritisation

ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
department: DPIIT
objective: Provide early-stage capital for proof of concept, prototype and market entry
benefit_summary: Grant for validation and prototyping, plus convertible debenture or debt for scale-up
coverage: National; DPIIT-recognised startups incorporated within a prescribed period
application_mode: Online (Startup India portal, via selected incubators)
data_source: Startup India Seed Fund portal
notes: Applications are routed through empanelled incubators, not filed directly with DPIIT

ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
department: MSDE; NSDC
objective: Short-term skill training, upskilling and Recognition of Prior Learning with certification
benefit_summary: Free NSQF-aligned training with assessment, certification and placement assistance
coverage: National; youth and workers, with RPL for existing workers
application_mode: Online (Skill India Digital); Offline (empanelled training centre)
data_source: MSDE; NSDC; Skill India Digital
notes: Successive versions (1.0 to 4.0) changed funding and delivery model

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
department: Directorate General of Training
objective: Promote apprenticeship training by sharing stipend cost with employers
benefit_summary: Government share of apprentice stipend reimbursed to the employer via DBT
coverage: National; establishments engaging apprentices and the apprentices themselves
application_mode: Online (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in)
data_source: Apprenticeship India portal; DGT
notes: Formerly NAPS; stipend-sharing ratio set by scheme guidelines

scheme_name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
department: Ministry of Rural Development
objective: Placement-linked skill training for rural poor youth
benefit_summary: Free residential or non-residential training with mandatory placement linkage and post-placement support
coverage: National; rural youth 15-35 from poor households (relaxed for vulnerable groups)
application_mode: Offline (project implementing agency); Online (Kaushal Panjee)
data_source: DDU-GKY portal; Ministry of Rural Development
notes: Placement percentage is a contractual obligation on the training partner

ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
department: Indian Banks' Association model scheme
objective: Institutional credit for vocational training and skill courses
benefit_summary: Collateral-free education loan for skill courses with moratorium during training
coverage: National; candidates admitted to eligible NSQF-aligned courses
application_mode: Online (Jan Samarth / Vidya Lakshmi); Offline (bank branch)
data_source: Indian Banks' Association model scheme; Department of Financial Services
notes: Loan ceiling and eligible-course list are set by the IBA model scheme

ministry: Ministry of Education
department: Department of School Education and Literacy
objective: Arrest dropout at class VIII and encourage continuation to secondary stage
benefit_summary: Annual scholarship to selected students from class IX to XII, paid by DBT
coverage: National; class VIII students below a prescribed parental income ceiling
application_mode: Online (National Scholarship Portal)
data_source: National Scholarship Portal; Ministry of Education
notes: Selection is by state-conducted examination; renewal requires prescribed marks

scheme_name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
ministry: Ministry of Education
department: Department of Higher Education
objective: Support meritorious students from low-income families in higher education
benefit_summary: Annual scholarship for graduation and post-graduation, paid by DBT
coverage: National; top percentile of class XII boards below an income ceiling
application_mode: Online (National Scholarship Portal)
data_source: National Scholarship Portal; Ministry of Education
notes: Quota is allocated by board and stream; professional-course rates differ

scheme_name: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
objective: Scholarship support for OBC, EBC and DNT students at school and higher-education stages
benefit_summary: Pre-matric and post-matric scholarship, and top-class school education support
coverage: National; OBC, EBC and DNT students below an income ceiling
application_mode: Online (National Scholarship Portal / YASASVI portal)
data_source: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment; NTA
notes: Consolidated several earlier OBC/EBC/DNT scholarship schemes

scheme_name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
objective: Enable SC students to pursue post-matriculation education
benefit_summary: Maintenance allowance, fee reimbursement and additional allowances
coverage: National; SC students below a prescribed parental income ceiling
application_mode: Online (National Scholarship Portal; state portal)
data_source: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment; National Scholarship Portal
notes: One of India's oldest continuing scholarship schemes; delivered largely through states

ministry: Ministry of Education
department: Department of School Education and Literacy
objective: Integrated school education programme from pre-school to class XII
benefit_summary: Infrastructure, teacher training, learning materials and equity interventions to states
coverage: National; delivered to states, not individual applicants
application_mode: Not applicable (state-implemented programme, no citizen application)
data_source: Samagra Shiksha portal; Ministry of Education
notes: Institutional scheme: schools and states are beneficiaries, not individuals

ministry: Ministry of Education
department: Department of School Education and Literacy
objective: Provide one hot cooked meal to school children to improve nutrition and attendance
benefit_summary: Hot cooked mid-day meal in government and government-aided schools
coverage: National; children in classes I-VIII (and pre-primary in some states) in eligible schools
application_mode: Not applicable (automatic entitlement on school enrolment)
data_source: PM POSHAN portal; Ministry of Education
notes: Formerly the Mid-Day Meal Scheme; entitlement, not application-based

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
department: National Health Authority
objective: Health cover for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation for poor and vulnerable families
benefit_summary: Cashless family floater hospitalisation cover per year at empanelled hospitals
coverage: National; families identified by deprivation criteria, plus state extensions
application_mode: Offline (empanelled hospital; Ayushman Mitra; CSC); Online (beneficiary portal)
data_source: National Health Authority; PM-JAY portal
notes: Cover amount per family per year is set by scheme rules; several states run converged schemes

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat Health and Wellness Centres
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
department: National Health Mission
objective: Deliver comprehensive primary health care closer to the community
benefit_summary: Free essential drugs, diagnostics, screening and teleconsultation at upgraded facilities
coverage: National; universal at the facility level
application_mode: Not applicable (walk-in service at facility)
data_source: National Health Mission; Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
notes: Renamed Ayushman Arogya Mandir; infrastructure scheme with no citizen application

ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
objective: Partial wage compensation and nutrition support for pregnant and lactating mothers
benefit_summary: Conditional cash transfer in instalments on meeting maternal and child health conditions
coverage: National; pregnant women and lactating mothers, conditions apply by birth order
application_mode: Online (PMMVY portal); Offline (Anganwadi centre; approved health facility)
data_source: PMMVY portal; Ministry of Women and Child Development
notes: Instalment structure and birth-order conditions revised in the Mission Shakti reorganisation

scheme_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
department: Department of Rural Development
objective: Legal guarantee of wage employment days per rural household per financial year
benefit_summary: Guaranteed unskilled manual wage employment with statutory wage paid to a bank or post office account
coverage: National (rural); every rural household demanding work
application_mode: Offline (Gram Panchayat work demand); Online (NREGASoft)
data_source: MGNREGA portal; Ministry of Rural Development
notes: Rights-based statutory entitlement under the MGNREG Act 2005, not a discretionary scheme

scheme_name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
department: Department of Rural Development
objective: Mobilise rural poor households into self-help groups and build sustainable livelihoods
benefit_summary: Revolving fund and community investment support to SHGs, plus bank credit linkage
coverage: National (rural); rural poor households through SHG membership
application_mode: Offline (SHG formation via village organisation and block unit)
data_source: DAY-NRLM portal; Ministry of Rural Development
notes: Delivery is through SHG federations; individuals cannot apply directly

ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
department: Department of Rural Development
objective: Provide a pucca house with basic amenities to eligible rural households
benefit_summary: Unit assistance in instalments, plus MGNREGA labour days and toilet convergence
coverage: National (rural); households identified by prescribed deprivation criteria
application_mode: Offline (Gram Panchayat; block office); Online (AwaasSoft)
data_source: PMAY-G portal; Ministry of Rural Development
notes: Unit assistance differs for plain and hilly/difficult areas

ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
department: MoHUA
objective: Provide affordable housing to urban poor including a credit-linked interest subsidy
benefit_summary: Interest subsidy on home loans, plus assistance under beneficiary-led and partnership verticals
coverage: National (urban); EWS, LIG and MIG categories by vertical
application_mode: Online (PMAY-U portal); Offline (urban local body; CSC)
data_source: PMAY-U portal; Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
notes: Four verticals with different eligibility; CLSS operated through lending institutions

ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
department: Department of Rural Development
objective: Social assistance pensions for the elderly, widows and persons with disabilities below poverty line
benefit_summary: Monthly pension under old age, widow and disability verticals, with state top-up
coverage: National; BPL households in the respective beneficiary categories
application_mode: Offline (Gram Panchayat; municipal office); Online (NSAP portal)
data_source: NSAP portal; Ministry of Rural Development
notes: Central rates are low; most states add a substantial top-up, so the amount received varies widely

scheme_name: National Food Security Act entitlements (Public Distribution System)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
department: Department of Food and Public Distribution
objective: Legal entitlement to subsidised food grain for priority households and AAY families
benefit_summary: Subsidised food grain per person per month through fair price shops; portable via One Nation One Ration Card
coverage: National; priority households and Antyodaya Anna Yojana families
application_mode: Offline (fair price shop; district supply office); Online (state PDS portal)
data_source: Department of Food and Public Distribution
notes: Statutory entitlement under the NFSA 2013; ration card is the access instrument

scheme_name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
department: MNRE
objective: Enable residential rooftop solar adoption with free electricity up to a monthly limit
benefit_summary: Central financial assistance on rooftop solar capacity plus concessional loan access
coverage: National; residential electricity consumers owning a suitable roof
application_mode: Online (National Portal for Rooftop Solar)
data_source: PM Surya Ghar portal; Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
notes: Launched 2024; subsidy slabs by sanctioned capacity, revised by notification
